row.proto: void *Game_SaveMgr_CreateSaveJob(void *jobs, uint64_t kind, uint32_t type, const char *save_name, uint64_t a5, uint64_t a6, uint64_t a7, uint64_t a8, uint64_t a9)
row.notes: thunk (jmp, no .pdata) -> .data1 0x150bf6c00, the save-job factory: looks the job type (param 3) up in the job map (jobs+0xd8..+0x110) and constructs a 0x518-byte job with 0x14364a310, passing kind and save_name (the save folder name; on Steam files are savegame@<save_name>#<file>). The profile save/load requests (.data1 0x150bf28c0 SaveProfile, 0x150bfbb30 LoadProfile, behind thunks 0x1436595b0 / 0x1436598e0) call it with (saveMgr+0x38, 1, 0, "profile" 0x1456e6f9e, ...); 0x14365a1b0 / 0x14365a530 with highlights%03d. The five trailing u8 flags travel in 8-byte stack slots; the binding declares them uint64_t so a wrap forwards the slots unchanged. Signature anchored in the bytes before the thunk (no unique pattern on the thunk alone). Raised by native-1990 for the F1 1990 save separation (doc:/mnt/work/.f1-1990/addon/native-requests.md#N2)
